entries.name: Stamp duty on assignments and conveyances on sale (2 % of the amount, charged on the transferee)
entries.statute: Stamp Act Cap. 82:01 s. 3 and Schedule item 14 (conveyance or transfer on sale: 'the transferee'), Schedule as amended by the Stamp Act (Amendment of Schedule) Order 2019 ('Assignment/Conveyance: 2% of amount'; persons primarily liable: 'the assignee or transferee'); GRA-posted copy (2024), OCR R4/fetch/p13/gm_stamp_act.pdf.ocr.txt. Liability: the transferee (purchaser) [text version: Stamp Act Cap. 82:01 with the Schedule as amended by the Stamp Act (Amendment of Schedule) Order 2019, GRA-posted copy of 2024]
entries.doc: Stamp Act (Amendment of Schedule) Order 2019, Schedule: 'Assignment/Conveyance | 2% of amount | The assignee or transferee'. Thirteenth pass.
unsupported: other instruments (fixed D500 duties, debentures 2 %, mortgages and further charges 0,5 %, leases by annual-rent bands)
transfers of shares: the rate is not legible in the scanned 2019 Order
conveyances of property other than land and buildings

entries.name: SSHFC National Provident Fund, employer contribution (10 %)
entries.statute: Social Security and Housing Finance Corporation Act 2015 s. 40 (1)-(3) (OCR of the gazetted Act, gm/law/sshfc2015_ocr.txt) [text version: SSHFC Act 2015 as gazetted; no amendment located (flag)]
entries.doc: s. 40 (1): the employee contributes five per cent and 'the employer shall contribute ten per cent of the basic salary or wages of the employee to the same Fund'; (2)-(3): an employer under the National Provident Fund pays fifteen per cent and may deduct five per cent as the employee's contribution.
unsupported: base is basic salary or wages (allowances excluded): the model applies it to wages
